theHorizontalAxisShowsElapsedHoursProduc: The horizontal axis shows elapsed hours. Production is a percentage of the base rate; the center shows recovery bonus.
ratesAreRecalculatedFromTheCrewOnShiftZe: Rates are recalculated from the crew on shift. Zero output while the whole room rests or the B shift is empty is expected; morale refilling or the next shift restores it. The center shows the current crew''s recovery bonus.
theDashedLineMarksTheInspectedMomentClic: The dashed line marks the inspected moment. Click a chart to inspect it.
selectOperatorCardsToDisplayTheirMoraleC: Select operator cards to display their morale curves.
